video_summary.overall_goal: Open WiFiAnalyzer and view Wi-Fi network details, channel ratings, and signal/channel graphs.
video_summary.description: The recording starts on the Google Play Store page for WiFiAnalyzer. The user opens the app, views access point details, switches between Channel Rating, Time Graph, and Channel Graph tabs, then returns to Channel Rating.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Google Play Store page for WiFiAnalyzer is visible with the app name, app icon, Uninstall button, Open button, preview images, and sections like Links, Permissions, and Versions.
steps.system_response: The Play Store begins opening the WiFiAnalyzer app.
steps.visual_feedback: The screen changes away from the Play Store page.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: A mostly blank light screen is visible while the app loads.
steps.visual_feedback: The blank screen remains briefly before the app interface appears.
steps.intent_task: Wait for the app to finish opening.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The WiFiAnalyzer Access Points screen is visible. It shows the current connection at the top, a warning that Wi-Fi scan throttling is enabled, and a list of detected Wi-Fi access points with signal strength, channel, frequency, distance estimate, vendor information, and security labels.
visible_ui_elements: Wi-Fi scan throttling is enabled warning
steps.system_response: The access point list remains visible while the user reviews the detected networks.
steps.visual_feedback: The finger moves over the list; no major screen change is visible.
steps.intent_task: Review available Wi-Fi access points and their signal details.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Access Points screen is still visible with the bottom navigation bar.
visible_ui_elements: Wi-Fi scan throttling is enabled warning
steps.system_response: The app switches to the Channel Rating screen.
steps.navigation_change: Access Points screen changes to Channel Rating screen
steps.visual_feedback: The Channel Rating tab becomes selected.
steps.intent_task: View recommended Wi-Fi channels and channel ratings.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Channel Rating screen is visible. It shows the current connection, the Wi-Fi scan throttling warning, best channels, star ratings, channel numbers, and access point counts.
visible_ui_elements: Wi-Fi scan throttling is enabled warning
steps.system_response: The app switches to the Time Graph screen.
steps.navigation_change: Channel Rating screen changes to Time Graph screen
steps.visual_feedback: The Time Graph tab becomes selected.
steps.intent_task: Open the graph that shows signal strength over scan count or time.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Time Graph screen is visible. It shows a graph grid, signal strength axis, scan count axis, and a legend listing several Wi-Fi networks.
visible_ui_elements: Wi-Fi scan throttling is enabled warning
steps.system_response: The graph screen remains visible while data is displayed.
steps.visual_feedback: The graph grid and network legend remain on screen.
steps.intent_task: View Wi-Fi signal strength graph information.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Time Graph screen is visible with the graph grid and bottom navigation bar.
steps.system_response: The app switches to the Channel Graph screen.
steps.navigation_change: Time Graph screen changes to Channel Graph screen
steps.visual_feedback: The Channel Graph tab becomes selected and colored channel shapes appear on the graph.
steps.intent_task: View Wi-Fi networks plotted across channels.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Channel Graph screen is visible. It shows multiple colored Wi-Fi network shapes plotted against signal strength and Wi-Fi channel numbers.
visible_ui_elements: Wi-Fi scan throttling is enabled warning
steps.system_response: The app switches back to the Channel Rating screen.
steps.navigation_change: Channel Graph screen changes to Channel Rating screen
steps.visual_feedback: The Channel Rating tab becomes selected.
steps.intent_task: Return to the channel recommendation/rating view.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Channel Rating screen is visible again. It shows best channels, channel rating stars, channel numbers, and access point counts.
visible_ui_elements: Wi-Fi scan throttling is enabled warning
steps.system_response: The screen remains on Channel Rating.
steps.visual_feedback: The Channel Rating data remains visible without a new screen transition.
steps.intent_task: Review the recommended Wi-Fi channels and their ratings.

overall_flow: Open WiFiAnalyzer from the Google Play Store.
Wait for the app to launch.
Open Channel Rating to see recommended channels.
Open Time Graph to view signal graph information.
Open Channel Graph to view networks by channel.
Return to Channel Rating and review the recommendations.
human_readable_step_summary: Step 1: The user opens the WiFiAnalyzer app from its Google Play Store page.
Step 2: The app shows a loading screen while it opens.
Step 3: The app opens on the Access Points screen and shows nearby Wi-Fi networks.
Step 4: The user taps Channel Rating to see Wi-Fi channel recommendations.
Step 5: The user taps Time Graph to view Wi-Fi signal information as a graph.
Step 6: The user stays on the Time Graph screen and looks at the graph area.
Step 7: The user taps Channel Graph to see Wi-Fi networks plotted by channel.
Step 8: The user taps Channel Rating to go back to the channel rating view.
Step 9: The user stays on the Channel Rating screen and reviews the best channel information.
